row: Turramurra Veterinary Hospital is a family owned, independent and multi award winning veterinary practice in Ku Ring Gai on Sydney's upper North Shore. We are the proud winners of an Australian Veterinary Association Practice of Excellence Award, a New South Wales Chamber of Commerce Business Ethics Award and several other awards. We would be delighted to greet you and your four legged friends at our boutique veterinary hospital. Small enough to care, experienced enough to trust, we will treat your pet as though they were our own.
